newsitem.title: USA: Advest is takeover target - BusinessWeek.
newsitem.headline: Advest is takeover target - BusinessWeek.

text.p: Two major Boston-based banks have approached Advest Group Inc about a potential takeover of the brokerage at $30 to $35 a share, according to BusinessWeek magazine.
The report, which quoted an investment manager in New York, said one of the banks has a stake of more than 5.0 percent in Hartford, Conn.-based Advest, whose stock closed Thursday at 18-1/8.

The same bank has bought stakes in other brokerages in anticipation of takeovers, including a stake in Alex. Brown & Sons before it was acquired by Bankers Trust New York Corp in April, BusinessWeek said.
Both banks are attracted to Advest's operations for institutional customers, including retail brokerage, investment banking, stock trading and asset management.
Advest officials were not available for comment on the report. BusinessWeek said Advest did not return calls seeking comment.
